Word Structure Analysis:
- Interdisciplinary: Prefix "inter-" (meaning between or among) + Root "discipline" (meaning a branch of knowledge or learning) + Suffix "-ary" (forming an adjective).
- Traditional: Root "tradition" + Suffix "-al" (forming an adjective).
- Academic: Root "academ" (from academy) + Suffix "-ic" (forming an adjective).
- Boundaries: Root "bound" + Suffix "-ary" + Plural suffix "-ies".
- Prefix: Prefix "pre-" + Root "fix".
- Means: Root "mean" + Suffix "-s" (third person singular verb).
- Between: Root "between" (no affixes in this context, though historically from "by" + "twain").
- Among: Root "among" (no affixes in this context).
- Refers: Root "refer" + Suffix "-s" (third person singular verb).
- Branch: Root "branch" (no affixes).
- Knowledge: Root "know" + Suffix "-ledge" + Suffix "-s" (plural noun).
- Learning: Root "learn" + Suffix "-ing" (gerund/noun).
